FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Stitch & Style Custom Apparel, we specialize in providing high-quality embroidery and custom apparel services tailored to our clients' unique needs. Our operations involve a state-of-the-art production facility equipped with commercial-grade machinery that is meticulously maintained to ensure safety and efficiency. We produce a variety of custom clothing items, including uniforms, promotional wear, and personalized gifts, primarily for businesses, schools, and corporate events. Our dedicated team follows strict quality control protocols, ensuring that all finished products meet our high standards before delivery. We take pride in our reliable supply chain, sourcing materials from established vendors to guarantee quality and consistency. Our commitment to health and safety is paramount; all staff members undergo training on equipment use and safety protocols, fostering a safe work environment. We operate within local regulatory compliance to ensure that our business practices are legally sound and responsible.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any high-risk repairs, including lithium-ion battery refurbishment, and confirms that all operations strictly adhere to local alarm and security requirements. Additionally, we ensure that the total contents value does not exceed $750,000 and do not offer any private or personal service components, such as medi-spa or cosmetic treatments.
